concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-dispute-add-text-evidence-node]] - Braintree Node.js text-evidence addition for `open` disputes, restricted to merchants with Control Panel dispute access, with plain and categorized evidence routes and a separate finalization boundary for submission to the banks
warnings: Keep evidence addition limited to disputes with status `open` and preserve the Control Panel dispute-access qualification.
Do not equate this page's phrase `submit textual evidence` with final submission to the banks; the separate approved finalize source owns that required action and the transition to `Disputed`.
Preserve that category codes apply when compelling evidence is required, that dispute reason codes can add validations, and that not all disputes require categorized evidence.
Keep the category inventory, conditional combinations, example values and routine limits behind the verified raw locators rather than copying them into the concept route.
Treat the linked Dispute response page and evidence-requirements guide as navigation only; neither was read as factual evidence for this source.
